plan: A melee fighter who wins long trades: the longer the fight, the harder he hits, and his ultimate finishes off weakened champions.
aSurveiller: His E (Apprehend). While it's available, keep your distance; once it's used, it's time to attack or run.
contrer: Don't stay in range of his E: it starts all of his fights.
When he casts his Q, hug him or back far away: the edge of the axe hurts most.
Avoid long fights: trade quickly, then leave before he stacks his bleeds.
forces: Extremely strong early and in extended melee fights.
Heals by hitting with the edge of his axe (Q).
His ultimate can be recast if he kills, letting him chain several kills.
faiblesses: Little mobility: he relies on his E to reach his target.
Easy to kite for ranged champions and those who slow.
Vulnerable to group focus once his E is used.

sorts.P: Each hit makes the target bleed; at 5 stacks, Darius becomes much stronger.
sorts.Q: Spins his axe: the edge hurts and heals him, the centre deals little damage.
sorts.W: Empowers his next attack, which heavily slows the target.
sorts.E: Pulls in enemies in front of him. It's his engage tool.
sorts.R: True damage execute, stronger with the number of bleeds on the target.

momentFort.voie: Very strong from the first levels, then even more dangerous from level 6 with his ultimate.
momentFort.jungle: Very strong in duels early, he ganks from level 3 by pulling with his E. Don't fight him in long fights.
